metadata.interpretation: Oracle boxes from human-corrected tracking GT; IDs removed from tracker input. This isolates association on an accessible tomato development subset, and is not detector performance, blueberry evaluation, or held-out superiority evidence.
limitations: No ignore-region protocol: converter must select foreground objects.
One accessible development sequence is insufficient to accept H1–H4.
No model selection on held-out test data was performed.

CPU timings are machine-specific. Warm association excludes first 5 frames; full online timing and cold first-frame latency are retained separately. End-to-end detector latency and GPU memory are not measured here.
